title: Apple HIG guides the design, and motion follows compositor-only rules
context: Control sizes, contrast and motion were chosen page by page, with no external guideline to settle disputes.
decision: Apple HIG is adopted as a guideline source and applied gradually, as pages are redesigned. Motion animates transform and opacity only and honours reduced motion; duration and easing values live in the sidecar. Landing motion tokens stay landing-scoped. There is no forced-dark-section rule.

alternatives.option: Apply HIG to every page at once
alternatives.reason: A sweeping redesign with no per-page review.
Nothing settles a disagreement about size, contrast or motion.

consequences: HIG rules reach a page only when that page is redesigned, so the app stays mixed for a while.
Motion that animates layout properties is a review finding.
revisitTriggers: HIG adoption proves too broad to apply page by page.
